t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green and purple gnomes are better in the first 2 rounds and shorter gnomes are better in the 3rd and 4th rounds. Basket colors determine the different rounds.

vb_textbox.text: I honestly could not tell a difference in which gnomes gave the highest points per round.  I followed the advice given to me and it did not seem to make a difference between the color or shape of the gnomes.
